core_conclusion: Display the spatial fields of the saved, converged JE NT 8 V candidate on the existing XY0_Z2 mesh; the plots do not certify physical or mesh accuracy.

panels.meaning: E dot (Jn + Jp), evaluated from the complete drift-diffusion current
Total coupled stress C:strain - e^T E - beta*theta; includes elastic, piezoelectric and thermal contributions
The local thermal constitutive contribution -beta_xx*theta; not a separately equilibrated pure thermal-stress solution

supplement: Temperature-rise cloud maps and carrier comparisons among the three planes.
evaluation: Original HEX20 shape functions and derivatives; exact plane evaluations. Gradients at internal interfaces use the element on the positive-z side. Surface gradients are one-sided from material.
rendering: Triangles remain within original element patches; no scattered-data smoothing or triangulation across the hole. No fabricated radius-2 or radius-4 results.
normalization: Overview maps use linear local ranges stated by their colorbars so weak midplane carrier changes remain visible. Three-plane comparisons use a shared range for each quantity. Signed carrier and signed current-work maps are centered at zero; no quantile clipping or gamma adjustment.
verification: Match reconstructed 5x5x5 Gauss-point fields and volume integrals to saved native outputs; inspect final rendered figures and editable vector text.
statistics: Deterministic FEM postprocessing; no statistical replicates or error bars.
